text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: “—This is the path I have chosen.”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...What is it?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be someone who guides you— who 
guides all of you."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...Tch, shut up, shut up, shut UP!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaargh—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Sirius Symboli! She 
brilliantly claims the Derby crown!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa!
(Waaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ………… ...Ha, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Alright! Got it...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(The title of Derby Umamusume is mine. 
With this, another one crossed off the 
list—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...Still, what was that "voice"...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH, that was incredible! That final 
burst was insane!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I got chills! The Sirius branch of Symboli 
is no joke either!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"She was a favorite of the Symboli family 
from the very start, wasn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But to think she actually became a 
Derby Umamusume. I'll definitely need to 
keep a close eye on her from now on...!

The world's eyes are upon her. This will 
surely be the foothold she needs to step 
onto the global stage!

I rushed toward the underground tunnel to 
congratulate her. But—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Don't get carried away forever. ...Next 
up is the Kikuka Sho, right?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Holding off the fierce onslaught with a 
textbook front-running strategy, she 
claimed victory by 3/4 of a length. 
Becoming the first undefeated Triple Crown 
champion in Japanese history.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...That assembled throne must have 
glittered so brightly in that very moment.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"To overwrite that, a worthy run will be 
required. In other words—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Who else is there?

She won that Japan Derby. She stood at the 
pinnacle of her generation, and yet—

I had no idea she would remain so fixated 
on Symboli Rudolf right up until that 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Regardless, next up is the Kikuka Sho. We 
need to build stamina to prepare for the 
long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll win for sure. I'll win—and paint over 
everything...!

"My feelings toward Symboli Rudolf are 
merely one of many motivations."

Seeing her steadily push forward, I had 
felt reassured, but...

That evening, a flicker of unease flared 
up once again—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Making a fuss the moment you get home. 
...What do you want?

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wanted to consult with you as soon 
as possible! You see—

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
We were wondering if you would accompany 
Rudolf-san on her overseas challenge...!

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
"Timeline-wise, the plan is to proceed as 
soon as the upcoming Kikuka Sho is over."

A "companion" for an overseas campaign 
refers to an Umamusume who acts as a 
training partner and confidante for the 
main contender, fulfilling a supportive 
role.

Even if it's not the main focus, entering 
the race is possible... and above all, 
it's a great chance to scout the course.

First of all, would her pride even allow 
her to take on the role of Symboli 
Rudolf's companion—?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...It's annoying, but weighing the pros 
and cons, it's not a bad deal.

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Let me do it. I'll throw away my useless 
pride for this.

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Change of plans. Reorganize everything.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Chances like this don't come around often. 
I wanna run on their turf.

...Indeed, they say the turf in Japan and 
Europe is quite different. If you can run 
in that race, it will be an invaluable 
experience.

And so... We abruptly changed course 
toward an overseas expedition.

The situation began changing rapidly from 
an unexpected direction.

First is the Kikuka Sho. And after that, 
preparing to be a travel companion.

In addition... I also need to properly 
address that issue I noticed after the 
race.
